name: Blackout Kit v1.1.1 - Software Bill of Materials

creationInfo.comment: versionInfo records the declared install floor from pyproject.toml, which is the security minimum validated against the GitHub Advisory database (GHSA) - it is not a lockfile pin. Requests and urllib3 are absent on purpose: Blackout Kit imports neither, so their CVE floors (requests>=2.32.3, urllib3>=2.2.2) do not apply, and no unused package is added to pin them.
